sql_query:
SELECT o.produce_name AS PRODUCE_NAME,
       SUM(o.sales) AS "Total Sales"
FROM tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_orders o
WHERE {SLICER_CONDITIONS}
GROUP BY o.produce_name
ORDER BY SUM(o.sales) DESC
LIMIT 10
description: Top 10 products by total sales (sum of sales) filtered by slicers.

query_name: Sub-Category: Return Rate %, Profit Margin, Total Sales
sql_query:
SELECT o.sub_category AS SUB_CATEGORY,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) END AS "Return Rate %",
       CASE WHEN SUM(o.sales) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE SUM(o.profit) / NULLIF(SUM(o.sales),0) END AS "Profit Margin",
       SUM(o.sales) AS "Total Sales"
FROM tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_orders o
LEFT JOIN tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_returns r
  ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE {SLICER_CONDITIONS}
GROUP BY o.sub_category
ORDER BY SUM(o.sales) DESC
description: Per sub-category metrics: return rate (distinct returned orders / distinct orders), profit margin, and total sales.

query_name: Region: Total Sales, Total Orders, Return Rate %
sql_query:
SELECT o.region AS REGION,
       SUM(o.sales) AS "Total Sales",
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS "Total Orders",
       CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) END AS "Return Rate %"
FROM tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_orders o
LEFT JOIN tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_returns r
  ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE {SLICER_CONDITIONS}
GROUP BY o.region
ORDER BY SUM(o.sales) DESC
description: Region-level operational scorecard: total sales, distinct total orders, and return rate.

query_name: Total Sales by Year and SEGMENT
sql_query:
SELECT YEAR(o.order_date) AS Year,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.segment = 'Consumer' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Consumer,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.segment = 'Corporate' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS Corporate,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.segment = 'Home Office' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS "Home Office"
FROM tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_orders o
WHERE {SLICER_CONDITIONS}
GROUP BY YEAR(o.order_date)
ORDER BY YEAR(o.order_date)
description: Yearly pivot of total sales by segment (Consumer, Corporate, Home Office).

sql_query:
SELECT o.ship_mode AS SHIP_MODE,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS "Total Orders"
FROM tiger_data_engineering.global_superstore_gold.gold_orders o
WHERE {SLICER_CONDITIONS}
GROUP BY o.ship_mode
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) DESC
description: Donut source: total distinct orders aggregated by ship mode.
